summary.headline: Astrological Questions on Illness and Law
summary.text: Chapters 348–364 of an astrological question catalog, treating accusations, fugitives, slave purchases, imprisonment, letters, requests, servants’ loyalty, exile, lawsuits, bloodletting, surgery, purgatives, illness, taking to bed, and diseases from the stars. Several entries cite Maximus and give judgments based on the Moon, Sun, nodes, houses, the ascendant, and the midheaven.
